entry: signal at close[i]; enter open[i+1]; exit close[i+h] — no same-bar look-ahead
benchmark: cross-sectional: forward return market-demeaned by same-day universe mean (beta-neutral)
inference: moving-block bootstrap over calendar dates, block_len=max(5, horizon) — overlap-aware: i.i.d.-date CIs read several times too tight on 10/21d. n_days = distinct dates, n_indep = independent blocks, n_obs = inflated ticker-day count

out_of_sample.note: each cell.oos grades the held-out tail; holds_oos = full edge did not flip adverse there. Under-powered relative to the full window — a stability read, not a second proof.

regime.definition: risk_on = SPY above BOTH its 50d and 200d SMA, else other
regime.note: cell.by_regime splits the edge; an edge only in risk_on is beta in disguise.

multiple_testing.note: A bootstrap p of 0.0 means 'below 2/n_boot', not 'zero', and BH rejects it at rank 1 for every family size by arithmetic. Cells whose floor sits above the critical value are escalated to more resamples; any that still cannot be resolved read fdr_state='unresolved' and survives_fdr=false.

caveats: Survivorship: delisted losers' bars don't exist on Alpaca IEX, so that half of the bias stays a bound (portfolio_backtest survivorship stress). The BACKFILL half is corrected when universe.pit is enabled — names contribute no pre-index-inclusion history.
RVOL and gap are computed on IEX partial-tape volume / non-auction open → indicative, not tradeable, unlike close-based RSI/MACD (indicative_only=true).
Thresholds are trading lore, graded IN-SAMPLE over a single (mostly bull) regime; treat any thin edge as unproven.

pit.note: Point-in-time S&P membership (data/sp500_changes.json): a name added mid-window contributes no pre-inclusion history and the beta baseline is computed on members only. NDX-only names have no event history and pass unconstrained. Removes the backfill bias; the missing-delisted-losers bias remains a stress bound.
